story: The Bornean Peacock Pheasant (Polyplectron schleiermacheri) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Phasianidae family. It is most commonly observed in Primary lowland and hill forest; dipterocarp forest; favoring areas with ridges, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Endangered (EN) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Bornean Peacock Pheasant is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Bornean Peacock Pheasant into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
